name: Azul
publisher: Next Move Games / Plan B Games
description: Draft colored tiles from the factories and lay them on your wall in rows and columns for points. Watch the floor line.

intro: **Built from the official rulebook** posted by Next Move Games on their [Azul page](https://www.nextmove-games.com/en/azul/azul-game/) ([PDF](https://cdn.svc.asmodee.net/production-nextmove/uploads/sites/4/2024/06/EN-Azul-Rules-Next-Move-web.pdf)).
The text was transcribed from the PDF's pages, and the boards and examples sit next to the rules they belong to. Tap any page image to see it as printed.
